name: Artisan trials award profession XP at level 1 for Woodcutting and Skinning (#12463)
contract: Issue #12463: Both Hardcore - Artisan's Guild (56) and Ironman - Lonely Artisan (167) failed to grant profession XP at level 1 for Woodcutting, Woodworking and Skinning.

1) Hardcore - Artisan's Guild (56) awards XP in mod-coa-challenges OnPlayerUpdateSkill only when IsProfessionSkill(skillId) is true. In SkillLine.dbc Woodcutting (732) and Woodworking (757) are SKILL_CATEGORY_SECONDARY (9), so IsProfessionSkill excluded them and their skill-ups granted 0 XP.

2) Ironman - Lonely Artisan (167) uses core Player::RewardProfessionXP (XPSOURCE_PROFESSION). At level 1 (next-level XP 400) with default Rate.XP.Profession=0.2, BaseFraction=0.02 and Rate.XP.Global=0.9295, orange Skinning (400*0.02*0.2*0.55*1.05=0.924) and orange Woodcutting (0.5544) truncated to 0 in RewardProfessionXP, and 1 XP awards truncated to 0 under Rate.XP.Global=0.9295.

Requires mod-coa-challenges enabled (CoAChallenges.Enable=1, CoAChallenges.ProfessionXP.PointsPerLevel=50), default Rate.XP.Profession=0.2, Rate.XP.Profession.BaseFraction=0.02, Rate.XP.Global=0.9295, and dynamic XP .xp 1.

Expected: at level 1 (next_level_xp 400), Lonely Artisan (167) earns 1 XP on orange Skinning (0.924 clamped to 1) and 1 XP on orange Woodcutting (0.5544 clamped to 1) and 0 XP on gray Skinning; Artisan's Guild (56) earns 7-8 XP (400/50 = 8, floor(8 * 0.9295) = 7) on Woodcutting and Skinning skill-ups (1->2) and 0 XP when Woodcutting is capped at 75/75 (no skill-up), with level remaining 1 after every gather. Before the fix, Lonely Artisan earned 0 XP on both and Artisan's Guild earned 0 XP on Woodcutting.
